# Tests that fail in every full run, each section with its reason. The check
# skips them. A manual run with "known_failures" runs them as a report that
# never fails the check.
#
# A pull request that fixes one of these deletes its line in the same pull
# request. One gtest filter pattern per line.

# Each test below was run alone, one process per test, and fails alone too.
# (Run together in one process, a failure in a fixture's SetUp could leave
# OpenFHE's process-wide parameter estimate set and make later contexts fail
# with "EstimateLogP() failure"; that is not the reason for any line here.)

# Inherited from upstream (they fail on the base commit 0ec4055):
# GPU bootstrap precision.
# Linear transform: error of about 2.6 against OpenFHE.
OpenFHEBootstrapTests/OpenFHEBootstrapTest.LinearTransform/*
# Coefficients to slots, parameters 3, 5 and 7: error of about 5e-11.
OpenFHEBootstrapTests/OpenFHEBootstrapTest.CoeffsToSlots/3
OpenFHEBootstrapTests/OpenFHEBootstrapTest.CoeffsToSlots/5
OpenFHEBootstrapTests/OpenFHEBootstrapTest.CoeffsToSlots/7
# Chebyshev evaluation with FIXEDAUTO scaling: error of 2.5e-7 where the other
# parameters reach 5e-10. The GPU evaluation differs from OpenFHE's by about
# 1e-4 after a full bootstrap, the same size as the bootstrap's own error
# against the true plaintext, so it is not a measured precision loss; where the
# difference comes from has not been found.
OpenFHEBootstrapTests/OpenFHEBootstrapTest.ApproxModEvalSparse/1

# Inherited from upstream: CPU and GPU results differ bit for bit.
OpenFHEInterfaceTests/OpenFHEInterfaceTest.MultAllLevels/1
OpenFHEInterfaceTests/OpenFHEInterfaceTest.ExtractContextShowPtMult/1
OpenFHEInterfaceTests/OpenFHEInterfaceTest.ExtractContextShowPtMultAllLevels/1
